excludedCommandsReason: Local file exports are deferred: a checked path string is not an atomic write capability. Full sources are retained; use existing host file tools to save browser results.

excludedSites.zlibrary: Not in Cindy's default catalog: copyright enforcement history and unverified mirror ownership (reviewed 2026-10-23).
excludedSites.slock: Deferred: app.slock.ai redirects to app.raft.build; the adapter still assumes the old origin and token storage. Revalidate before inclusion.
excludedSites.claude: Excluded: Claude subscription login and use belong to the unmodified built-in Claude Code CLI, not a Claude.ai browser adapter (credentials-and-local-storage.md).
excludedSites.spotify: Deferred: client credentials still depend on a plaintext spotify.env file. Do not bundle until credential configuration uses the host encrypted store.
excludedSites.ones: Deferred: the login adapter accepts account passwords as model inputs and prints reusable bearer tokens. Login must use the existing trusted input handoff instead.
excludedSites.xiaoyuzhou: Deferred: authenticated adapters require manually configured access/refresh tokens without a host secure configuration entry. Plaintext credential fallback is removed; the independent public Cindy recipe remains available.
excludedSites.paperreview: Deferred: submit returns a reusable review capability token and review/feedback accept it as a model input. Keep capability credentials inside the host before inclusion.
excludedSites.quark: Deferred: share-tree returns a reusable share capability stoken and save accepts it as a model input. Keep capability credentials inside the host before inclusion.
excludedSites.kimi: Deferred: storage-get returns arbitrary Web Storage values and cookies exposes credential previews. Remove these diagnostic credential exits before inclusion; no model-facing raw secrets.
